name: Crush the Uninvited

stealth.details: (legendary); DC 20 Perception check to notice the warning carved in the door frame

disable: DC 48 Thievery check (legendary) to scratch out the warning or Dispel Magic (10th rank; counteract DC 48) to counteract the magic in the warning

items.name: Implosion
items.text:
Trigger A creature passes through the doorway without Kemnebi's permission

---

Effect The trap casts implosion on the triggering creature. This is a 10th-rank Implosion spell that deals 85 untyped damage (DC 47 basic Fortitude save).

text: A warning carved into the door frame magically crushes any who pass through the doorway without Kemnebi's permission.
